findings.title: reroute is journalled before the spawn, so a refused launch leaves a false "this attempt runs on X" entry and re-journals it every retrying pass
the kernel's "rework evidence NOT captured" journal always blames a superseded candidate, even for a log carrying no `candidate:` header, where pack.json correctly says "unbindable"
the non-convergence stop exists only on the `testing` FAIL path, so a `merging -> rework` validation loop accumulates the streak and reroutes but never reaches `rework_nonconvergence_max`
